title: The Sinking Mother
text: A woman stands waist-deep in the black water, her arms held out, humming. She is looking at the most tired of you as if she has been waiting for them all her life.

outcomes.text: She holds them under, gently, a long time. What climbs out is green and dripping and still knows your names.
She kisses their brow and is gone. They come back calmer, holding something she gave them.
The humming follows you a while and then stops. The Leader does not stop hearing it, and walks into the next fight half in a dream.
The humming follows you all day.

options.label: The Minstrel hums her tune back to her.

outcomes.text: She stops, and listens, and sinks out of sight smiling. The tune is the Minstrel's now, and it has power in it.
She stops, and listens, and takes the Minstrel's voice down into the water with her.
